scenario.title: Correct a date mid-conversation
scenario.situation: You want a routine visit next Thursday morning, but change your mind to Friday.
scenario.objective: Clearly correct Thursday to Friday after the agent first discusses Thursday.
scenario.probes: Say 'Sorry, I meant Friday, not Thursday.' Verify the final day and time.
scenario.expected: Retains the corrected date, clarifies availability, no stale-day confirmation.

timestamp_note: Offsets from capture start; transcript times are turn commits, not word-aligned speech times. Audio timing uses frame arrival.
recap: I couldn't verify my record, so I couldn't schedule the appointment. They transferred me to patient support for help.
